verdict.detail: Same country, catalogue number and year as the first issue (UK, BS 001, 1980). Discogs lists 5 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
This version has "Marketed by Nems Recording Corp." on the bottom left of the back cover, as well as stereo recording info and copyright info, which is all in fairly small print and difficult to see as it blends into the image. The inner sleeve says MADE IN ENGLAND R.S. 2-82. At the bottom of the slip,it's only printed on 1 side.

Recording information:
Tracks A1-A5 recorded Live 11.03.1973 in Manchester, Hardrock Concert Theatre, The United Kingdom
Tracks A6-B3 recorded Live 16.03.1973 in London, Rainbow Theatre, The United Kingdom

Recorded live by:  Ossie Osbourne ... Tony Iommi ... Geezer Butler ... Bill Ward at Manchester and The Rainbow ... London
Ozzy's name is misspelled. It is printed Ossie on the back of the album cover.
Marketed by Nems Recording Corp. ℗1980
All songs published by Essex Music International Ltd. Made in the UK.
